text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to shake off her disappointment, Narita Brian is having difficulties applying herself to training ever since she missed the chance to race against Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take it upon myself to ask Symboli Rudolf for a scrimmage, and we set up a match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the result—Narita Brian loses by a neck.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she sees a much bigger gap in their abilities and attributes the defeat to her overconfidence. The two of us accept the loss and use it as fuel to improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Narita Brian officially challenges Symboli Rudolf, and word of this shocking development spreads throughout the school.
